hero.title: How We Build
hero.headline: FROM OPPORTUNITY TO OPERATING BUSINESS.
hero.description: SZ Ventures turns real-world problems into functioning businesses through disciplined execution, operational capability, and scalable infrastructure.

stages.name: Identify
stages.headline: REAL PROBLEMS FIRST.
stages.description: Find opportunities where real-world problems create room for new businesses with clear customer need and viable unit economics.

stages.name: Build
stages.headline: FOUNDATION & INFRASTRUCTURE.
stages.description: Develop the people, systems, partnerships and infrastructure required to make the opportunity real, testable, and operational.

stages.name: Operate
stages.headline: FIELD-LEVEL EXECUTION.
stages.description: Put the business into the field, deploy real workflows, and build operational intelligence through direct, physical execution.

stages.name: Scale
stages.headline: EXPANSION THROUGH PROVEN MECHANICS.
stages.description: Expand what works through distribution, technology, workforce capacity, and strategic partnerships.

operating_layer.name: People
operating_layer.description: Recruited, vetted, and coordinated talent driving execution on the ground.

operating_layer.name: Technology
operating_layer.description: Targeted digital systems, communications layers, and operational tools.

operating_layer.name: Data
operating_layer.description: Real-world signals, verification logs, and structured feedback loops.

operating_layer.name: Partnerships
operating_layer.description: Collaborations with industry leaders, platforms, and enterprise clients.

operating_layer.name: Operations
operating_layer.description: Standard operating procedures, governance, and daily management.

operating_layer.name: Distribution
operating_layer.description: Direct access to enterprise demand, local communities, and consumer channels.
